prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, landscape, not a finished book page. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Pocket of Wind; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: A fictional garden with a low forked apple tree, short lawn and low brick wall, windy afternoon. A removable blue zip pouch holds captured wind only in this story.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Blue cloth zip pouch small enough for Zoe’s palm; Red diamond kite with one short white tail; Kite string and wooden spool; Low forked tree
 Create a clean separated reference board on white: show the principal recurring props/animals in front, side and three-quarter views, their relative scale beside any named human cast, and a single simple location key showing the persistent setting and daylight/palette. The human character model sheet is a supporting identity reference, not content to copy wholesale. Show only the subjects this book requires. Use initial object states: Pouch separate from clothing; this is explicit fantasy; kite lies on grass.. For orientation, the opening location/action is: Zoe holds the mouth of a blue pouch into a garden breeze; Kit watches beside the low apple tree. Exact continuity: Pouch separate from clothing; this is explicit fantasy; kite lies on grass.. Do not show a completed craft or later scene merely because the finished object is listed in design locks. No future story events, no captions.

visualReview.note: Direct inspection: canonical Kit/Zoe, palm-size blue zipped pouch with open/closed designs, red diamond kite single short white tail, wooden spool, low forked apple tree and brick garden wall. No future trapped-kite event.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
